selection.name: random350_v3
selection.indexing: 0-based test_epi_num into the habitat episode iterator
selection.strategy: per-scene slots proportional to scene size (Hamilton), drawn uniformly within scene, then max-spread play order (adaptive same-scene cooldown, random among eligible)

category_coverage.note: a single set of n<categories cannot be complete; the union of all sets is what covers the label set

play_order.note: slots between consecutive episodes of the same scene; 1 == back to back
